item.title: Knife-wielding man on Brooklyn Bridge cables fatally shot after ignoring orders to drop weapon
item.description: Police have fatally shot a knife-wielding man on a cable of New York City's Brooklyn Bridge after he ignored orders to drop the weapon and came within feet of an officer

item.title: Widow of airman killed in Mideast is upset she was told Iran wasn't a war while sorting out benefits
item.description: The widow of an airman killed on a combat mission in the Middle East says it took a viral social media post to get clarity from the Pentagon on issues related to her husband’s benefits and basic pay months after his death

item.title: Judge clears a lawsuit against Kyrsten Sinema under North Carolina's 'homewrecker' law
item.description: A judge has ruled that former U.S. Sen. Kyrsten Sinema can be sued under North Carolina's homewrecker law

item.title: Chimpanzees once used for vaccine research get health checks as part of long-term care
item.description: Chimpanzees once used in hepatitis B vaccine experiments are getting health checks at their new home in Liberia

item.title: Nearly 2,000 fall ill in suspected food poisoning linked to Indonesia's free school meals program
item.description: Nearly 2,000 people, most of them students, have fallen ill in suspected food poisoning outbreaks linked to Indonesia’s Free Nutritious Meals program between Sept. 1 and Sept. 3

item.title: Endometriosis can elude diagnosis for years. What to know about the disease and new ways to find it
item.description: Diagnosing endometriosis is often a challenge

item.title: Here's how the summer box office blew up and Hollywood got its mojo back
item.description: Hollywood has just wrapped up its best summer in a decade and its biggest vibe shift since the pandemic

item.title: In 'Primetime,' Robert Pattinson takes on the 'irresistible' role of Chris Hansen
item.description: Robert Pattinson didn't plan to play Chris Hansen in “Primetime,” which debuts Saturday at the Venice Film Festival, but it became irresistible

item.title: Even snakes have to audition for the opera at the Met. Princess the boa constrictor got the part
item.description: The Metropolitan Opera in New York requires auditions for everyone on stage

item.title: Hiring burst of 162,000 jobs in August puts the focus squarely back on inflation in the US
item.description: The U.S. job market rebounded in August as employers added a surprising 162,000 jobs

item.title: Former Cowboys running back Emmitt Smith is sued by investor over wind farm project
item.description: NFL career rushing leader Emmitt Smith is being sued by a Native American investment company over claims that the former Dallas Cowboys running back and his business partners misappropriated a $2.5 million loan that was supposed to fund a wind farm project in Texas

item.title: Records reveal safety complaints, poor maintenance at site of deadly Washington pulp mill disaster
item.description: A pulp mill in Longview, Washington, where 11 workers died after a chemical tank collapsed in May had a history of safety complaints, poor maintenance and discharges of toxic chemicals

item.title: Feds open probe into Musk's steering-wheel-free taxis a day after he began offering rides in them
item.description: Tesla is facing a probe into the safety of its steering-wheel-free Cybercabs a day after the company run by Elon Musk launched the taxi service with fanfare

item.title: Rescue satellite gets close to NASA's doomed telescope, even if it can't save it
item.description: A private spacecraft that was supposed to save NASA's sinking Swift Observatory has managed to come within nine miles of the doomed spacecraft and even snap pictures

item.title: ICE officer charged in Minnesota shooting released on bond
item.description: A U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer has been released from federal custody after appearing in court on charges of lying to investigators about the circumstances that led to the shooting of a Venezuelan man during the Minnesota immigration crackdown last winter
